verdict.rationale: Meltano ships a first-class, extensively documented CLI (`meltano init`, `meltano add`, `meltano config`, etc.) that is central to its 'CLI-first' design philosophy, confirmed by docs and community reports of using it to run pipelines and add connectors. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or examples of AI-agent-driven CLI usage (e.g., agent orchestration, MCP-style tool wrapping) and independent hands-on confirmation from an AI-native workflow specifically.
